response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, AVG(t.amount) AS average_transaction_amount FROM account AS a JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, average_transaction_amount, AVG(average_transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY frequency) AS mean_account_average FROM account_averages) SELECT account_id, frequency, average_transaction_amount, average_transaction_amount / NULLIF(mean_account_average, 0) AS ratio FROM frequency_averages ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
